name: gizza-ai/strip-ansi-codes
summary: Remove ANSI escape & color codes from terminal output

tool.description: Remove ANSI escape and color codes from terminal output, leaving clean readable text. scope='all' (default) strips every escape sequence (colors, cursor/erase control, OSC strings); scope='color' strips only SGR color/style codes and keeps cursor/erase control.

text.description: The terminal text (with ANSI escape codes) to clean.
